text:
elaine: Quick design question — when an admin flips the org-level SSO toggle, do we surface an 'SSO required' indicator inside the roles matrix row, or only show it on the org banner? I’m worried about discoverability and clutter.
kevin: I lean toward a compact pill in the row next to role name (e.g., small lock + 'SSO'). keeps context. but density could suffer on mobile. :thinking: 
sam: If we add a pill it must be keyboard-focusable and include a tooltip accessible via focus. also needs an accessible name — can't be color-only.
anita: Microcopy thought: instead of 'Enforce SSO' on the toggle, use 'Require SSO for access' — clearer for non-technical admins.
kevin: Agree on copy. 'Require SSO' reads like an action. Will mock both variants.
elaine: Another thing: audit logs are buried. current path is Settings > Org > Security > Audit log. Could we put a quicklink on the roles page header — 'View audit trail' — which opens a side panel filtered to access events?
sam: Side panel is fine but don't trap focus. Prefer modal with focus restore and a keyboard shortcut (e.g., press 'g' then 'a' to open audit). Also when opening from an invite, preselect filters like action=invite or role_change.
designbot: uploaded mock: sso_matrix_rows_v2.png (see attachments) :eyes:
kevin: For the header quicklink we should show a tiny last-updated timestamp + 'View audit trail' link. Copy for the panel title: 'Audit trail for access changes' vs 'Audit log for org changes' — I prefer the first, it’s more specific.
anita: Agree. Also compliance wants the panel to expose the user_id + ip + action fields by default.
sam: Accessibility nit for the role pill: add aria-label="SSO required for this role" and ensure screen readers read it before the role name when focused. Also ensure contrast: WCAG AA for pill bg/text.
kevin: Visual option: a subtle lock icon + 12px pill, hover shows full reason and when it was enabled. On very small screens collapse to icon-only with tooltip.
elaine: OK — next steps: @kevin make two microcopy variants in Figma and share links; @sam can you spec the focus/ARIA behavior and shortcuts; @anita confirm compliance fields for the audit panel. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to sign off.
kevin: will post Figma links by EOD.
sam: will draft keyboard interactions and aria spec today.
anita: I’ll confirm fields and reply here by noon.
designbot: reminder: prototype upload scheduled: 1768401200 — will add interactive flow for mobile.
elaine: thanks all :thumbsup:
